items.t: Battery pack may let water in (recall)
items.job: Recall: inspect and reseal or repair high-voltage battery enclosure

items.t: Battery pack connections may be welded wrong (recall)
items.job: Recall: inspect battery pack, replace if needed

items.t: Battery module part may be loose inside pack (recall)
Battery or motor control software sets warning codes
items.job: Reprogram battery and drive motor control modules (service update)
items.note: Done free under warranty or the service update.

items.t: Glitches fixed by vehicle-wide software updates
items.job: Dealer software reprogramming of vehicle modules
items.note: GM covers these programs at no charge.

items.t: Taillights stay off or stay on (recall)
items.job: Recall: replace rear taillight assemblies as needed

items.t: Heater blows cold and windows will not defrost
items.note: Usually covered under the bumper-to-bumper or EV component warranty when the truck is new enough.

items.t: Roof panels leak water into the cabin
items.job: Reseal or replace roof panel weatherstrips
items.note: Usually a warranty repair on newer trucks.

items.t: Front seat belt buckle bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Recall: tighten front seat belt buckle bolts

items.t: Rear drive motor wiring can short (recall)
Will not charge, Service Engine Soon light
items.job: Diagnose charging system (onboard charger, charge port, software)
items.note: Usually covered by the EV component warranty; parts cost depends on what failed.

items.t: Rolls on a slope with one-pedal driving, Service ESC
items.job: Diagnose brake and stability control systems
Diagnose and replace wiper switch or control module

items.t: Sudden loss of drive power from rear motor failure
items.note: Covered by the EV component warranty on new trucks; a similar recall job takes about six hours.

items.t: Driver assist and Super Cruise unavailable
Rear seat belt bracket loose (missing nut)
items.job: Install missing seat belt anchor nut

items.t: Multiple warning lights come on at once
items.job: Scan all modules and update software
